title: LayTracer: Fast two-point seismic ray tracing in layered media
description: LayTracer is an open-source Python package for computing ray paths, travel times, and path-dependent scalar quantities in horizontally layered (1D) velocity models. Version 0.3.1 adds reusable critical-angle detection helpers in laytracer.amplitude and laytracer.plot.coefficient_panels() for multi-panel reflection and transmission coefficient plots. The release refactors example 3 to use the new shared helpers, adds regression tests for the critical-angle and plotting utilities, and refreshes the citation, credits, and API-reference documentation.
